add.name: GitStatus
add.description: Show the working tree status: staged, unstaged and untracked changes, as `git status --short` prints them.

add.name: GitLog
add.description: Show recent commits, newest first. Optionally limit how many.

max.description: How many commits to show. Defaults to 10.

add.name: CargoTest
add.description: Run the test suite for the current crate. Optionally filter by a substring of the test name.

filter.description: Only run tests whose name contains this substring.

add.name: CargoCheck
add.description: Type-check the current crate without producing a binary. Faster than a full build.
